title: Quiet supplies
body: A bandage and a bat share a medical-center bag; the note on its tie says to leave the back room quiet until the wash is finished.
rival_reading: A response team could have cleaned a treatment room after an emergency; the note does not say what was washed.
gloss: A first-aid kit is held back while a room is washed.

cites.quote: stuff you can use as weapons here
